counter_definitions.assigned: Unique real-world provider/service candidates identified for this country, including not-yet-processed; exclude queries, URLs, generic reference groups and aliases from provider counts.
counter_definitions.processed: Unique candidates actually substantively reviewed from retained primary evidence/current official reads or actual specific blocked attempt, with saved disposition; unvisited search-only leads are not processed.
counter_definitions.fully_verified: Processed candidate with branch identity/exact address(or real mobile service area)/phone/official website/current named veterinarian and actually published veterinary qualification or role/local cancer service/access verified. Board oncology certification and exact building coordinates are not prerequisites; unknowns explicit. GP chemotherapy allowed. No requirement to assign every drug to a specific named doctor.
counter_definitions.NEW: Unique provider/service absent semantically from FULL current baseline. Separate inherited_unpublished_revalidated from new_discovery_this_run. Previously published61 are ALREADY_APPLIED/DUPLICATE, not NEW.
counter_definitions.UPDATE: Unique existing current-main identity with exact field-scoped old/new deltas. Count fields separately.
counter_definitions.DUPLICATE: Real identity already represented or alias; aliases not separate clinics.
counter_definitions.EXCLUDED: Named candidate with evidenced out-of-scope/nonpromotion reason, not unsupported absence claim.
counter_definitions.UNRESOLVED: Named processed candidate with exact missing fact/URLs/actual attempts/next allowed step; external restrictions separate from own unfinished.

completion_rule: All documented dimensions and accessible discovered frontier performed and reconciled. No available unprocessed leads/unreviewed rosters/search directions. Only precise external obstacles/ambiguities with permitted routes exhausted may remain. No universal-proof-of-absence requirement.
safety: Official primary full sources, snippets only leads
Short supporting quotes, branch scope, actual checked_at precision
No generic lump/general-surgery⇒cancer; no diagnostic-radiology⇒radiotherapy; no network⇒branch
No source-specific permission/auth/CAPTCHA bypass or query/Unicode/alternate-client evasion
Old controller blanket offline pause superseded by this new owner run, but actual held actions remain. Unknown DE scope isolated; not a global ban on proven-independent sources
No source-success date renewal from failed attempt or integration
required_worker_report_sections: Identity, actual work period, real agent ID
Coverage table for every dimension with actual evidence
Defined provider counters and separate aliases/reference/URL/query counts
Named eligible providers/updates with city/treatment/official URLs; already-live separate
Own accessible remainder separate from precise external gaps
Evidence/identity/backup validation with remote branch/SHA/report path
checkpoint_protocol: Own root six files initialized before spawn. After each meaningful block, create immutable checkpoints/block-N/manifest.json plus frozen report/result/remaining and changed candidate-level records/evidence/query append-only shards; ready.json lists SHA256 of every file in block. Notify parent. Parent stages only immutable, checksum-stable files and serializes remote backup+readback. Do not duplicate full cumulative payload every block. Final six full files sealed once. Worker never commits/pushes.
